'''Iychtor''' was the fifth, outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|sun]] [[Velus]]. It was located in the [[Velus system]]<ref name="CoreWorlds" /> of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="AtlasCorr" /> The [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Stone/Legends|rock]] planet had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="CoreWorlds" /> Iychtor, along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], was located along the [[Shawken Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], connecting it to the [[Shawken system/Legends|Shawken]] and [[Thokos system/Legends|Thokos systems]]. The Velusia system, and therefore Iychtor itself, was also connected by another hyperlane to the [[Scipio system/Legends|Scipio system]].<ref name="Routes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Iychtor was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CoreWorlds" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Velus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Iychtor, in grid square L-9.<ref name="AtlasCorr" />
